remarks.zh: 计算橱柜的板材尺寸。[宽度], [高度], [深度] 是总测量值，[板材厚度] 是顶部、底部和侧面板的材料厚度，[背板厚度] 是背景板的材料厚度。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] is total Measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Background Board material thickness.
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] adalah ukuran keseluruhan, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah dan sisi, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk lemari. [Width], [Height], [Depth] adalah ukuran total, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah, dan samping, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดแผ่นสำหรับตู้ [Width], [Height], [Depth] คือขนาดรวม [BoardThick] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นด้านบน ด้านล่าง และด้านข้าง [BackBoardThick] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นด้านหลัง (AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính toán kích thước bảng cho tủ. [Width], [Height], [Depth] là kích thước tổng thể, [BoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu bảng trên, dưới và bên, [BackBoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu bảng nền. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga sukat ng board para sa isang kabinet. Ang [Width], [Height], [Depth] ay kabuuang Sukat, ang [BoardThick] ay materyal na kapal ng Itaas, Ibaba, at Gilid na Lupon, ang [BackBoardThick] ay materyal na kapal ng Background na Lupon. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.my: တွန်းကိုပယ်ရန်ပစ္စည်းများကိုတွက်ချက်ပါ။ [Width],[Height],[Depth]သည်စုစုပေါင်းတိုင်းတာခြင်းဖြစ်သည်၊ [BoardThick]သည်ပင်မ၊အောက်နှိမ်နှင့်ဘေးဘက် ပစ္စည်းအထူကိုဖြစ်သည်၊ [BackBoardThick] သည်နောက်ခံဘော်ဒါပစ္စည်းအထူ ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ (AI translated, please check)
